supportUsPage.title: Support Us
supportUsPage.callToActionDescription: We are a grassroots community that is not supported by any institutional donors or philanthropies. We rely almost solely on small donations from our community members, so every bit of it actually counts.
supportUsPage.callToActionContact: If you want to support us, send us a message in this
supportUsPage.transparencyDescription: We are dedicated to achieving the most with the limited resources we have. We want to cultivate trust in the movement, which is why we are committed to publishing all donations we receive and our expenses. Individual donors can still remain anonymous if they wish; we will publish only whether they are from within or outside our community.

transparencyPage.title: Legal & Operational Transparency
transparencyPage.description: Official registration details, governing statute, non-profit governance, and contact information for A.O. Uniunea Vegetarienilor din Moldova.
transparencyPage.overviewText: vegan.md is an official educational and community initiative operated by A.O. Uniunea Vegetarienilor din Moldova (Public Association Vegetarian Union of Moldova), an independent, non-profit, non-commercial organization registered in the Republic of Moldova under Law no. 86/2020 on Non-Commercial Organizations.
transparencyPage.indicatorNonProfitText: Per Statute Articles 1.7, 1.8, and 6.4, the association operates solely for public benefit; surplus funds cannot be distributed to members or private individuals and are reinvested exclusively in statutory goals. Upon dissolution, remaining assets transfer to a non-commercial organization with similar aims (Art. 10.10–10.11).
transparencyPage.indicatorMissionText: Our statutory goals (Statute Art. 3.1) focus on animal rights and protection, public education on plant-based health and nutrition, environmental sustainability, civic engagement, and open community resources.
transparencyPage.indicatorGovernanceText: The supreme governing body is the General Assembly of members (Statute Art. 4.4), which elects the Administrator and oversight bodies (Censors Commission / external audit) for 3-year mandates.
transparencyPage.indicatorFinancialText: Per Statute Articles 2.11 and 7.1, the association publishes annual activity reports and openly discloses community donations and expenses.
